title: MC Portfolio Registry v1
description: HOME-dir registry of products managed by MC. Lives at ~/.mc/portfolio.json.

repo_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the product's working directory.

github_url.description: Optional GitHub remote URL. null if not yet created.

mc_version.description: MC version installed in this product (from framework-installed.json). null if unknown.

last_synced.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last registry write for this entry.

role.description: Product's relationship to MC. 'product' is the common case.

remote_type.description: Remote hosting type. Only 'github' is implemented in v1.

kind.description: Forward-compat extension point. Reserved for future product classification.
